themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying demands for 'national priority' policies, prioritizing citizens over immigrants in social services, housing, and welfare. This theme appears in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, with Vox, Lega, and Sverigedemokraterna leading the charge, often clashing with coalition partners over implementation.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia's government formation, prioritizing Spaniards in social aid and public services.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega pushes for citizenship revocation for criminals, sparking debates on immigration and national identity.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes halting deportations of teens and advocates for stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes immigration policies and advocates for national preference in welfare and housing.

themes.title: Modi-Meloni diplomacy reshapes EU-India ties
themes.blurb: The growing strategic partnership between India and Italy, exemplified by PM Modi's visit to Rome and meetings with PM Meloni, is a dominant theme in right-wing media. This alliance focuses on trade, defense, and the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), signaling a shift in EU foreign policy priorities.
